post.caption: The Zip necklace from Van Cleef and Arpels has a working zipper. The idea is credited to the Duchess of Windsor around 1938, and it took the house more than a decade to perfect before the first Zip was finished in the early 1950s. Slide the zipper open and it hangs as a necklace. Remove the back section and it zips shut as a bracelet. In May 2026 a 2012 Zip necklace sold for 619,200 Swiss francs.
